assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production-ready background artwork for a mystery visual novel's interactive casebook, NOT a screenshot or a complete UI mockup.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only, a premium antique collage book UI. Generate a NEW original blank open detective journal spread with the same visual production quality: cream cotton rag paper with photoreal tactile fibres, delicate foxing, worn uneven deckled edges, warm tea stains ONLY near outer margins, layered loose documents peeking behind, tactile spine crease and subtle depth. Precisely straight-on orthographic view, a wide double-page spread, ratio about 1.73:1, fills entire image with book. Transparent outside the slightly irregular book silhouette. Warm pale ivory, muted brown ink and faded maroon accents. Very fine Victorian engraved corner flourishes and thin ornamental double-line frames, pale blue ruled lines on the right page very faint. One small faded violet stamp and a blue-gray vintage postage stamp peeking behind top left, engraved pointing-hand postage stamp tucked bottom right, entirely without letters/numbers. Both pages must be mostly blank clean pale ivory so the game engine can overlay readable text. Left page's usable blank region x6%-47% y10%-90%; right page x55%-94% y10%-87%. Center spine at x50%. Detailed printed ink, embossed texture, paper layered shadows, collector's edition detective-game polish. No modern flat vector look, no simple beige rectangle, no large coffee rings in content areas, no text at all, no alphabet, no Chinese, no logo, no watermarks, no characters, no desk or surrounding scene. Preserve true alpha outside the book.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: actual game UI background asset, a tactile antique newspaper collage sheet with blank areas for interactive typography, portrait aspect about 0.8:1. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE only. Produce original high-end mystery-AVG art matching the paper material and typographic richness of the reference, not a flat beige rectangle. Single straight-on vintage off-white newspaper on translucent parchment backing, torn deckled outer edge, fine paper fibre, faded sepia lithography, restrained yellow-brown foxing, layered lower corners, soft realistic edge shadows. Subtle engraved detective objects (fountain pen nib, old key, magnifying glass, celestial diagram) and extremely fine ornamental rules occupy NARROW outer margins; a small dark-red wax seal overlaps the right edge around y45%. Wide empty pale column x8%-84%, y13%-85% reserved for three huge menu words and must remain readable. Header and footer have thin vintage dark gray newspaper rules. Peripheral micro-layout uses only tiny abstract horizontal printing lines, NOT fake letters or lorem ipsum. Newspaper monochrome charcoal/sepia, cream rag-paper grain, hints faded maroon. No rendered menu words, no characters, no logos, no English, no Chinese, no numbers, no watermarks. The sheet fills the image, transparent alpha outside its irregular outline, do NOT show a background room or desk. Render as a premium illustrated visual novel shipped asset with convincingly aged paper and fine etched collage details.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: usable transparent sepia engraved mansion floor-plan map for an interactive detective game, no words. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the crisp antique architectural plan. Output a NEW vertically arranged TWO-FLOOR mansion plan, straight orthographic TOP-DOWN 2D architectural linework, portrait canvas ratio 0.93:1. Transparent background, brown-black slightly distressed printed ink. Real continuous thick masonry walls, wall openings, windows, hinged door arcs, staircase treads, tiny schematic beds/desks/bookshelves/tables/cupboards and cooking fixtures, fine hatch shading. NOT a grid of UI buttons or detached rectangular boxes. Preserve the following normalized room zones on the full canvas so the game can overlay native labels and clickable regions:
UPPER floor: three connected service rooms at x.06-.33, x.35-.63, x.65-.94, all y.08-.19 (kitchen, pantry, storage). Dining at x.06-.33 y.21-.32; a long corridor x.35-.94 y.21-.32. Lounge x.06-.33 y.34-.45, entrance hall x.35-.63 y.34-.45, study x.65-.94 y.34-.45. Connect with door openings; a small entrance porch projects from entrance hall below y.45. Narrow staircase fits at x.02-.06 y.21-.45.
LOWER floor: three bedrooms at x.06-.33, x.35-.63, x.65-.94, all y.62-.76. Horizontal passage x.06-.94 y.78-.86. Three bedrooms at same x ranges y.88-.99. Bed heads and small desks along edges, keeping each room CENTER relatively empty for label overlays. Staircase at x.02-.06 y.65-.90. Draw shared walls rather than gaps wherever possible, connect all bedrooms to passage with door swings.
Leave empty transparent band y.48-.59 separating the two floors and some breathing room at top. No labels, no numbers, no room titles, no icons of people, no pins, no UI panels, no typography, no paper background. Architectural drawing must feel like an authentic period estate atlas, sophisticated engraved detail, all fine details sharp enough for full-screen gameplay.
